title: Will Katie Zacharia be out as White House Press Secretary before Oct 24, 2026?
rules: If Katie Zacharia leaves as White House Press Secretary before Oct 24, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
Katie Zacharia must have an actual departure date and vacate the role within the time period.

Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract shall settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

blind.reasoning: Zacharia took office around Oct 9–13, 2026, and only about nine days remain before the deadline. Her debut was widely panned, officials told CNN she may not last, and a bar complaint challenges her claim to be a lawyer, so the risk is above normal. Still, firing a press secretary within two weeks would be almost unprecedented, and the White House is publicly backing her. The viral 'resignation' post appears to be a parody.
blind.falsifier: Before Oct 24, 2026, Trump or the White House announces that Zacharia has resigned or been replaced, or a new press secretary takes the podium in her place.

final.reasoning: The market's 12.5% sits above my estimate, which I raised slightly to 9% given the open internal doubts and the law-license controversy. Removal within about two weeks of starting is extremely rare and the window is under nine days, so NO at about 0.87 looks modestly underpriced.
